selected.name: 锐角疾速
selected.direction: Extreme angular futurist TD ligature. Broad razor-cut strokes, engineered chamfers, diagonal negative-space channels, compact fast silhouette and sharp terminals. Acid yellow-green against graphite black with white wordmark. Flat two-dimensional silhouette, no gradients, no chrome. Distinctive cyber-industrial graphic design, athletic motion without generic swooshes. Small custom angular ToolDawn wordmark.

selected.name: 复古典藏
selected.direction: An elegant nineteenth-century inspired TD intertwined monogram: expressive high-contrast serif letters, bracketed serifs, graceful swash on the T integrating into a handsome D, both clearly readable. Wine red and warm ivory with subtle printed-ink character, sophisticated book-publisher identity, not wedding calligraphy. Large monogram on uncluttered ivory background, small ToolDawn wordmark in refined serif. No badge or ornamental frame.

selected.name: 自由签名
selected.direction: A bespoke lowercase td signature mark drawn in one confident black brush gesture, dynamic calligraphic thick/thin rhythm, one long t cross-stroke and open-loop d, both readable. Black expressive ink on pale apricot with a small electric orange accent. Fashion atelier meets creative studio, asymmetrical airy composition. Clean ToolDawn wordmark quietly below. Not a generic script font; a striking custom hand-lettered logo.

selected.name: 街头涂写
selected.direction: Bold original TD graffiti handstyle monogram, broad expressive marker strokes, controlled overlaps, energetic uneven baseline, unmistakable T and D, youthful graphic streetwear identity. Hot orange and saturated magenta with black keyline on a light lilac background. Crisp artistic vector-like lettering with a few purposeful paint flicks, not messy illegible wildstyle. Small clean contrasting ToolDawn wordmark. No mascots, stars, smileys or stock symbols.
